description: This file defines a snapshotter for capturing DOM and stylesheet states, including a class 'Streamer' that intercepts style sheet modifications, observes DOM mutations, and generates DOM snapshots with resource overrides for stylesheets. It is part of Playwright's internal trace recording system.

classes.name: Streamer
classes.description: A class responsible for capturing DOM snapshots, intercepting stylesheet modifications, observing DOM mutations, and managing snapshot state for Playwright tracing.

methods.name: frameSnapshotStreamer
methods.description: Initializes the snapshot streamer, setting up mutation observers, method intercepts, and exposing the 'Streamer' instance on the window object.
